name: Fine-Density Counterfactual Residual Gate (FDCRG)
rationale: The genuine fine reader is slightly better than a repeated-coarse control in standalone macro-F1 and materially better in NLL/Brier, yet a fixed blend harms ARFTR. The density contrast is therefore treated as a counterfactual evidence witness, not as a replacement model.
new_mechanism: Compute a bounded factor residual from the fine-versus-repeated-coarse logit contrast. Apply it only when ARFTR uncertainty, density-contrast direction, and multi-resolution consistency predict positive utility. Retain ARFTR is an explicit action.
inference_inputs: FineLocalMotion spatial and temporal moments, correspondence entropy, validity and observable crop quality
no support purity, annotation fields, or held labels

training_and_leakage.rule: fresh five-way inner coefficient/application cross-fitting is mandatory for gate utility targets; ARFTR M4/A3/P6 components must come from the verified nested scenario-held caches, while existing global OOF arrays may be used for descriptive diagnostics only
training_and_leakage.arftr_component_ancestry: verified nested three-way base caches from the retained ARFTR lineage; no new ARFTR neural fit was introduced
training_and_leakage.utility: cross-fitted loss_before - loss_after_action with an explicit zero-action class

decisive_gates.inner: do not launch outer gate fits unless the fixed action family has positive net utility in >=4/5 inner populations and retain action is selected on >=70% of rows
decisive_gates.proper_losses: NLL and Brier not worse than ARFTR
decisive_gates.audit: independent exact replay and zero outer-label reads

compute.preflight: one outer fold plus one inner split; no labels used for timing
compute.fit_budget: at most 50 small reader/gate fits; projected wall time must be <=20 minutes or shard and stop
compute.data: existing dense grid12/grid3 caches; no new human review or video extraction

stop_condition: If no positive inner utility, any outer fold has non-positive net, or the lower bootstrap bound crosses zero, close FDCRG and keep ARFTR unchanged.
primary_risk: The prior transition-risk router already found rare complementary cases; FDCRG is retained only because its counterfactual density witness is new. A negative result closes broad router variants.

result.closure: cached density correction branch closed; do not broaden router family
